Studied Vite plugin API surface (vite .d.ts, environment/createServer exports) and plugin-rsc internals (core/ssr.js, rsc.js, browser.js), mapping RSC environment setup to required subsystems.

Later /opt/reference reads are almost entirely about locating missing packages (react-server-dom-webpack, esbuild, vite transitive deps), not resolving framework semantics — research was not sustained into the build.

The long build/debug phase is dominated by terminal-stuck loops, npm/shell-escaping corruption, and dependency plumbing rather than targeted source re-consultation on ambiguous RSC/routing/cache behavior.

reasoning: The agent's upfront orientation was strong and systematic — it read every fixture shim, the relevant Vite plugin API, plugin-rsc's SSR/RSC/browser cores, Next.js CLI source, and the actual next shim implementations, grounding each next/* contract in a real signature (above the level-5 anchor, approaching 8). But it fell short of the 8/10 anchors because deep semantic mining of ambiguous behaviors (cache keys, action serialization, RSC boundaries) was thin, and research was not sustained: the entire build phase devolved into infrastructure/shell firefighting, with later reference visits used mainly to locate missing packages rather than resolve framework semantics. That places the observed level between 5 and 8, at a 6.
